//HerbalWashBlueprint: The recipe for CardData/Item/hw_herbal_wash.json, VANILLA CARDS ONLY so the fleas and lice cure never needs another mod (Documentation/Research/HarshWilds/afflictions.md section 2.5 point 3, the second fleas DECISION). A construction-style blueprint registered through HarshWilds/BlueprintTabs.json under the vanilla Survival > Medical tab, whose TabName.LocalizationKey 'Tab_1_Survival_Subtab_3_Medical_TabName' was read from the export's CardTabGroup/Tab_1_Survival_Subtab_3_Medical.json. Researchable from the start: StartUnlocked false with empty CardsOnBoard, TagsOnBoard and StatValues (the Community_Mod_Chest Bp_CMC_VillageHomeSign shape), basic research time BlueprintUnlockTicksCost HW_HERBAL_WASH_RESEARCH = 4, one stage of BuildingDaytimeCost 1 (the cap is 12). Ingredients: (1) any bog myrtle, fresh, dried or powdered, through the vanilla CardTabGroup GpTag_Myrtle (RequiredTabGroupWarpData, the Advanced Copper Tools precedent for GpTag_LeatherMedium; a tab group resolves by its runtime name, listed in ScriptableObjectObjectName/CardTabGroup.txt); (2) vanilla JuniperNeedlesDry (684f89c7e4f85764fb037b5da5bc21dc), because juniper has no tab group and fresh needles dry into these; (3) vanilla ClayBowl (a968f3eaffc6b9743b82982b5af2ab8c) with DontSpend true and no EffectOnIngredient, so BlueprintElement.DontDestroy keeps the bowl. The quantities are TUNABLE PLACEHOLDERS, session-inferred and unmeasured against play; whether the tab group accepts each myrtle form at a real build is a dispatcher harness probe.

CardDescription.DefaultText: Mash bog myrtle (fresh, dried or powdered) with dry juniper needles in a clay bowl to make a wash that drives out fleas and lice. The bowl is not used up.
